name: MultiValueDictionary
signature: public class MultiValueDictionary<TKey, TValue> : IReadOnlyDictionary<TKey, IReadOnlyCollection<TValue>> where TKey : notnull

docs.summary: A MultiValueDictionary can be viewed as a `IDictionary` that allows multiple values for any given unique key. While the MultiValueDictionary API is mostly the same as that of a regular `IDictionary`, there is a distinction in that getting the value for a key returns a `IReadOnlyCollection<TValue>` of values rather than a single value associated with that key. Additionally, there is functionality to allow adding or removing more than a single value at once. The MultiValueDictionary can also be viewed as a IReadOnlyDictionary<TKey,IReadOnlyCollection<TValue>t> where the `IReadOnlyCollection<TValue>` is abstracted from the view of the programmer. For a read-only MultiValueDictionary, see `ILookup<TKey, TValue>`.

members.name: Add
members.signature: public void Add(TKey key, TValue value)

docs.summary: Adds the specified `TKey` and `TValue` to the [`MultiValueDictionary<TKey,TValue>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary).
docs.remarks: Unlike the Add for `IDictionary`, the [`MultiValueDictionary<TKey,TValue>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary) Add will not throw any exceptions. If the given `TKey` is already in the [`MultiValueDictionary<TKey,TValue>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary), then `TValue` will be added to `IReadOnlyCollection<TValue>` associated with `key`

params.key: The `TKey` of the element to add.
params.value: The `TValue` of the element to add.

members.name: AddRange
members.signature: public void AddRange(TKey key, IEnumerable<TValue> values)

docs.summary: Adds a number of key-value pairs to this [`MultiValueDictionary<TKey,TValue>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary), where the key for each value is `key`, and the value for a pair is an element from `values`
docs.remarks: A call to this AddRange method will always invalidate any currently running enumeration regardless of whether the AddRange method actually modified the [`MultiValueDictionary<TKey,TValue>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary).

params.key: The `TKey` of all entries to add

members.name: Remove
members.signature: public bool Remove(TKey key)

docs.summary: Removes every `TValue` associated with the given `TKey` from the [`MultiValueDictionary<TKey,TValue>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary).
docs.returns: `true` if the removal was successful; otherwise `false`

params.key: The `TKey` of the elements to remove

members.name: Remove
members.signature: public bool Remove(TKey key, TValue value)

docs.summary: Removes the first instance (if any) of the given `TKey`-`TValue` pair from this [`MultiValueDictionary<TKey,TValue>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary).
docs.remarks: If the `TValue` being removed is the last one associated with its `TKey`, then that `TKey` will be removed from the [`MultiValueDictionary<TKey,TValue>`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary) and its associated `IReadOnlyCollection<TValue>` will be freed as if a call to [`Remove`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.MultiValueDictionary~Remove) had been made.
docs.returns: `true` if the removal was successful; otherwise `false`

params.key: The `TKey` of the element to remove
params.value: The `TValue` of the element to remove
